sentences.zh: 不好意思，但在那之前，我们要看粉红女郎们再次抵达，只是没有斯蒂芬妮。

sentences.en: And I just want to say, I don't understand why they can't drive Stephanie to school.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，我不明白她们为什么不能开车带斯蒂芬妮去学校。

sentences.en: Is that when they almost crash into the tree?
sentences.zh: 那是她们差点撞到树上的时候吗？

sentences.en: I don't think she likes to ride with them, lady.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她不喜欢坐她们的车，女士。

sentences.en: They almost run over Mr. Stewart upon arriving.
sentences.zh: 她们一到就差点把斯图尔特先生撞倒。

sentences.en: Mr. Stewart very quickly meets Miss Mason, aka Sexy McSexy, and he says he likes her hair.
sentences.zh: 斯图尔特先生很快遇到了梅森小姐，也就是性感大美人，他说他喜欢她的头发。

sentences.en: Mr. Stewart was played by Tab Hunter.
sentences.zh: 斯图尔特先生由塔布·亨特饰演。

sentences.en: So incidentally, both Connie Stevens and Tab Hunter, they were like matinee idols when they were younger.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，康妮·史蒂文斯和塔布·亨特年轻时都是午场秀偶像。

sentences.en: So the casting of these two was kind of a nod to the older audience.
sentences.zh: 所以选角这两个人也算是在向老观众致敬。

sentences.en: It reminds me a little bit of Us and Lee's movie, Angela.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了我们和李的电影《安吉拉》。

sentences.en: It's a movie about young people and rock and roll.
sentences.zh: 那是一部关于年轻人和摇滚乐的电影。
还有一些大家耳熟能详的老牌明星。

sentences.en: They sprinkle in some matinee idols of the past, and that's me and you and Fred Armisen and Bobby Lee, I think.
sentences.zh: 他们在片中点缀了一些过去的午场偶像，我想那就是我和你，还有弗莱德·阿米森和鲍比·李。
我们在李的电影里的工作。

sentences.en: I would do it all day long.
sentences.zh: 我愿意一整天都做这个。

sentences.en: It's super fun to be the oldies on set.
sentences.zh: 在片场当老牌明星超级有趣。

sentences.en: And we find out about the big talent show.
sentences.zh: 然后我们知道了大型才艺秀的事。
奖品是100张长期播放的唱片。

sentences.en: Well, now we're going to get to this little bit in the hallway between Johnny and the principal.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我们要讲到走廊里强尼和校长之间的那个小片段。

sentences.en: She's scolding him about riding motorcycles across the school lawn.
sentences.zh: 她正在训斥他骑摩托车碾过学校草坪的事。

sentences.en: And the whole time, he's hiding a cigarette in his mouth.
sentences.zh: 而整个过程中，他嘴里一直藏着一支香烟。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's smoking as she walks up, and he does the thing where he folds it into his mouth.
sentences.zh: 没错，她走过来时他正在抽烟，他做了那个把烟卷进嘴里的动作。

sentences.en: Yeah, this would drive me crazy.
I would have to skip this scene.
I don't like it that then his friend slaps him on the back and he swallows it.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢接下来他朋友拍了一下他的背，他就把烟给咽下去了。

sentences.en: This would make my sister and I crazy, this scene.
sentences.zh: 这一幕简直要把我和我姐姐逼疯了。

sentences.en: Well, I looked up how they did this gag, and according to the internet, actor Adrian Zamed confirmed it was a real cigarette, not a special effect.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下他们是怎么做到这个恶作剧的，根据网上的说法，演员阿德里安·扎梅德证实这是一支真正的香烟，而不是特效。

sentences.en: The bit was written into the movie by Ken Finkelman, who did this in high school.
sentences.zh: 这个桥段是由肯·芬克尔曼写进电影里的，他在高中时就干过这事。

sentences.en: So Zamed practiced this trick every day for roughly two months before shooting the scene.
sentences.zh: 所以扎梅德在拍摄这个场景前，大约花了两个月时间每天练习这个把戏。

sentences.en: He did hold the cigarette in his mouth, but he did not swallow it, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，他的确把烟含在嘴里了，但他没有把它咽下去。

sentences.en: I assumed that he did the flip.
sentences.zh: 我以为他做了那个翻转动作。

sentences.en: And then I assumed they took it out, and that whole time that he was talking to Miss McGee, he was just pretending to hop up.
sentences.zh: 然后我以为他们把烟拿出来了，他在跟麦吉小姐说话的整个过程中，只是在假装说话。

sentences.en: That makes it even harder for me to watch now, knowing that the cigarette was in his mouth the whole time.
sentences.zh: 一想到那根烟全程都在他嘴里，现在看这一段让我觉得更难受了。

sentences.en: He did say when the camera came onto his back, he didn't have the cigarette in his mouth anymore.
sentences.zh: 他说过，当镜头转到他的背影时，他嘴里就没有烟了。

sentences.en: But when he was facing forward, he did.
sentences.zh: 但当他正对镜头时，确实有。

sentences.en: Well, let's get to these talent show auditions, lady.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们来看看这些才艺秀试镜吧，老兄。

sentences.en: First, we have a riveting song about a guy named Brad by the Twins with Michael on piano.
sentences.zh: 首先，是一首由双胞胎演唱、迈克尔伴奏的关于一个叫布拉德的男人的引人入胜的歌。

sentences.en: So this guy, Brad, was played by Matt Lintanzi.
sentences.zh: 这个叫布拉德的家伙由马特·兰塔齐饰演。

sentences.en: He had a small part in Xanadu the year before where he met Olivia Newton-John, and then he got cast in Greece, too.
sentences.zh: 他在前一年的《仙纳杜的狂热》里演过一个小角色，在那里他遇到了奥莉薇亚·纽顿-约翰，后来他又参演了《油脂》。

sentences.en: And this whole time, he was Olivia Newton-John's boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 而且在这整个期间，他都是奥莉薇亚·纽顿-约翰的男朋友。

sentences.en: They actually ended up getting married.
They divorced after 11 years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 他们在结婚11年后离婚了。

sentences.en: But maybe this is why she was hosting all those parties, because her boyfriend was in the movie.
sentences.zh: 但也许这就是为什么她会举办所有那些派对，因为她男朋友也在电影里。

sentences.en: But also, I mean, Lorna Love said that just the whole cast was so warm to them.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，洛娜·洛夫说过整个剧组对他们都非常热情。

sentences.en: Well, now we have the pink ladies.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在轮到粉红佳人们了。

sentences.en: Michael is playing the piano again.
Sharon is clearly running the show.
The role of Sharon was originally going to be played by Jennifer Beals, but she left to take the lead role in Flashdance.
sentences.zh: 莎伦这个角色原本定由珍妮弗·比尔斯出演，但她为了去演《闪电舞》的女主角而辞演了。

sentences.en: But I think if I was going to be in this movie, like, when I was younger, I would have played Sharon.
sentences.zh: 但我想如果我要演这部电影的话，比如在我更年轻的时候，我会演莎伦。

sentences.en: I love this line that she says to Rhonda.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢她对朗达说的这句台词了。
她说，朗达，你的假发掉了。

sentences.en: Rhonda's like, give me a break.
Who would you have played, lady?
I could see you as Paulette.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你挺适合演保莱特。

sentences.en: Well, the Calendar Girls song, I find it so grating.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，《日历女郎》那首歌，我觉得太刺耳了。

sentences.en: I really hate the beginning with the uh-uh-uh-uh-uh-uhs, but so I'm going to play a clip.
sentences.zh: 我真的很讨厌开头那些呃呃呃呃呃的唱段，不过我要放一小段音频。

sentences.en: You're playing the song you hate?
sentences.zh: 你要放你讨厌的那首歌？

sentences.en: Yeah, because it's going to lead into a really cringy conversation between Michael and Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 对，因为这会引出迈克尔和斯蒂芬妮之间一段非常尴尬的对话。

sentences.en: I wanted to ask if you're free after school today.
sentences.zh: 我想问你今天放学后有空吗？

sentences.en: That's another line we would always quote.
sentences.zh: 这是我们以前总是引用的另一句台词。

sentences.en: The pink ladies get cut off after just one season, and Sharon is really upset.
sentences.zh: 粉红女郎只播了一季就被砍了，莎伦对此非常难过。

sentences.en: But Michael's going to hit up Stephanie again after the song, but she's too busy to go out.
sentences.zh: 但歌唱完后，迈克尔打算再次约斯蒂芬妮，不过她太忙没空出去。

sentences.en: He'd like to know, like, what was up with the bowling alley?
sentences.zh: 他想问问，保龄球馆那次是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And she's like, that was a joke.
sentences.zh: 而她的态度是，那只是个玩笑。

sentences.en: And then she forgot her book, so he asks her again.
sentences.zh: 然后她忘带书了，于是他又问了她一次。

sentences.en: He says, how about the day after tomorrow?
And she's going to explain what she's actually looking for.
sentences.zh: 她打算解释一下她到底在找什么样的对象。

sentences.en: I think we should hear it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该听听看。

sentences.en: She is so dynamic when she's singing.
sentences.zh: 她唱歌的时候太有活力了。

sentences.en: There's, like, this spotlight on her.
sentences.zh: 就好像，有一束聚光灯打在她身上。

sentences.en: She has this amazing red lipstick.
sentences.zh: 她涂着那种惊艳的红唇膏。
她全身穿着黑色的衣服。

sentences.en: She has a black top, black tight pants, black bangle bracelets.
sentences.zh: 她穿着黑色上衣、黑色紧身裤、黑色的手镯。

sentences.en: Her pink lady jacket is reversible lady.
sentences.zh: 她的粉红女郎夹克是两面穿的。

sentences.en: But if Michael didn't know really what she's into, her necklace is a dead giveaway.
sentences.zh: 但如果迈克尔真的不知道她喜欢什么类型，她的项链就是个绝佳的线索。

sentences.en: It's a gold necklace with a motorcycle pendant.
sentences.zh: 这是一条带有摩托车吊坠的金项链。

sentences.en: I wrote down, I think this is why she got the part.
sentences.zh: 我写下来了，我想这就是她得到这个角色的原因。

sentences.en: All during this first section of the song, there were these weird cutaways to Michael
sentences.zh: 在歌曲的第一部分，镜头一直奇怪地切到迈克尔

sentences.en: listening to her sing, and he's a complete, like, just blank slate.
sentences.zh: 听她唱歌的画面，而他完全就是一副面无表情的样子。

sentences.en: Well, I learned one of her dance moves.
sentences.zh: 我学会了她其中一个舞步。

sentences.en: I'd like to show it to you now.
sentences.zh: 我现在想把它跳给你们看。

sentences.en: No, that's not what I can't.
I have compassion for her because I'm looking at this whole scene through the camera lens,
sentences.zh: 我很同情她，因为我是通过镜头看整个场景的，

sentences.en: and she's got to cover a lot of ground in a short amount of time.
sentences.zh: 她必须在很短的时间内走过很长的一段路。

sentences.en: So she does this weird scooching dance move.
sentences.zh: 所以她做了这个奇怪的蹭地移动舞步。

sentences.en: I don't know how else you cover that amount of ground unless you can do cartwheels and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我不知道除了会侧手翻之类的人，你怎么还能走完那么长的距离。

sentences.en: But I was curious what Michelle Pfeiffer had to say about her audition process.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇米歇尔·菲佛对她的试镜过程有什么要说的。

sentences.en: I was curious about her background for singing and dancing.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇她唱歌和跳舞的背景。

sentences.en: And I found this interview of her on The James Corden Show.
sentences.zh: 我在詹姆斯·柯登秀上找到了她的这段采访。

sentences.en: Here's what she had to say.
Now, what was your audition process like for Grease 2?
sentences.zh: 那么，你当年为《油脂2》试镜的过程是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, it was a total fluke that I got that part.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我能得到那个角色完全是个巧合。

sentences.en: And I went on a lark.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是凑热闹去的。

sentences.en: I mean, my agent said, oh, just go.
And I was in this little short purple skirt with go-go boots.
sentences.zh: 当时我穿着一条紫色短裙，脚蹬Go-Go靴。

sentences.en: And we had the dancing auditions.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进行了舞蹈试镜。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's literally like a chorus line.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这简直就像合唱团的歌舞队排练。

sentences.en: It's like this line goes, and then the next line goes.
sentences.zh: 就像这排上，然后下一排上。

sentences.en: And I kept sneaking in the back.
And finally, it was only me.
sentences.zh: 最后，只剩下我一个人了。

sentences.en: And the director's like, come on, come on.
So I go and, you know, go down there.
sentences.zh: 于是我就去了，你知道的，走过去。

sentences.en: And I, you know, shockingly enough.
sentences.zh: 而且，说实话，挺让人震惊的。

sentences.en: And then we all got given Grease 2.
sentences.zh: 然后我们所有人都接到了《油脂2》。

sentences.en: And how could we be mad about that?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么会对此感到生气呢？

sentences.en: Well, here's what I wrote down.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我写下来的东西。

sentences.en: I wrote, she's so sexy when she's singing.
sentences.zh: 我写的是，她唱歌的时候太性感了。

sentences.en: And then she is so not sexy when they make her dance.
sentences.zh: 然后当他们让她跳舞时，就一点也不性感了。

sentences.en: And I just wrote, let this woman sing.
sentences.zh: 我刚写的是，让这个女人好好唱歌吧。

sentences.en: Why did this need to be a dance number?
sentences.zh: 为什么非得弄成一段舞蹈呢？

sentences.en: Because later, we're going to let Michael wax on for three minutes about his charade.
sentences.zh: 因为等会儿，我们要让迈克尔喋喋不休地讲上三分钟他的哑剧。

sentences.en: He doesn't have to dance through that song.
sentences.zh: 他可不用在那首歌里跳舞。

sentences.en: His whole ballad that, like, I can't even take.
sentences.zh: 他整首抒情歌，简直让我无法消受。
那纯粹是个巨大的蒙太奇。

sentences.en: Why couldn't she just stand there and sing like the powerhouse that she is?
sentences.zh: 她为什么就不能像个实力派那样站在那里唱歌呢？

sentences.en: And the thing is that, like, when you're seeing her face and her eyes,
sentences.zh: 关键是，当你看到她的脸和她的眼睛时，

sentences.en: Don't make this woman dance anymore.
sentences.zh: 别再让这个女人跳舞了。

sentences.en: I would say don't make her do any more than the ladder.
sentences.zh: 要我说，别让她做任何比梯子更难的动作了。
那个梯子非常让人惊叹。

sentences.en: It's got a tiny little top of the ladder that then she had to, like, kind of move around on.
sentences.zh: 梯子顶端非常小，她还得在那上面挪动身子。
我当时为她捏了一把汗。

sentences.en: And then the way she comes off that ladder is the coolest thing I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 然后她从梯子上下来那个姿势，是我见过最酷的。
配上她那大大的一条腿横扫？
我要是上去非得摔个四脚朝天不可。
我绝对会脸朝下摔个狗吃屎。

sentences.en: Because she goes down a few, then up a few, and then down a few more, and then up one.
sentences.zh: 因为她先往下下几格，然后又往上几格，接着再往下好几格，然后又往上一格。
就让她在梯子上待着吧。

sentences.en: But you know what you don't make her do when she's on the top of the ladder,
sentences.zh: 但你知道当她在梯子顶端的时候，绝对不能让她做的是什么吗，

sentences.en: which, again, kills the whole ladder bit?
sentences.zh: 这又一次毁了整个梯子的桥段？
为什么非要摆爵士手势？

sentences.en: Like, if you're dancing for your husband and you're being sexy,
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你在为丈夫跳舞，想要展现性感，

sentences.en: and then you start doing jazz hands, it's gone.
sentences.zh: 然后你突然开始摆起爵士手势，那就全毁了。

sentences.en: Or if he likes jazz hands, maybe there's another conversation to be had.
sentences.zh: 或者如果他喜欢爵士手势，那或许我们得另谈别论了。

sentences.en: Maybe you have a thing for jazz hands.
sentences.zh: 也许你就是对爵士手势情有独钟。

sentences.en: But I just think there's—you can't be sexy while doing jazz hands.
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得——你不可能在摆爵士手势的同时还保持性感。

sentences.en: There's not a single stripper who does jazz hands.
sentences.zh: 没有任何一个脱衣舞娘会做爵士手势。

sentences.en: I just also think that there's maybe a reason the ladder was part of this move,
sentences.zh: 我还觉得，梯子成为这个动作的一部分可能是有原因的，

sentences.en: because maybe they saw her do the scooch move, and they were like, we need a prop.
sentences.zh: 因为他们可能看到她做了那个挪动动作，然后就觉得，我们需要一个道具。

sentences.en: But it all falls apart when she—oh, God.
sentences.zh: 但当她——天哪，这一切都泡汤了。

sentences.en: Anyway, I both—I love Cool Rider, but the dancing is hard.
sentences.zh: 总之，我既——我很喜欢《Cool Rider》，但里面的舞蹈太难了。

sentences.en: That's all we have to say about that.
sentences.zh: 关于这个，我们要说的就这么多了。

sentences.en: I think we should take a break, and then when we come back—
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该休息一下，等我们回来——

sentences.en: Michael has figured out a way to buy a motorcycle,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔想出了一种买摩托车的方法，

sentences.en: and it includes selling essays and homework.
sentences.zh: 其中包含代写论文和家庭作业。

sentences.en: I break down the math of it.
sentences.zh: 我把其中的算盘打了一下。

sentences.en: And like Angela said before the break, the T-Birds are going to start asking Michael
sentences.zh: 就像安吉拉在休息前说的，雷鸟帮要开始找迈克尔

sentences.en: to do their homework for them.
They got a rep to protect.
They all are very worried about their reps.
sentences.zh: 他们都非常担心自己的声誉。

sentences.en: Yes, their rep of doing their own homework.
sentences.zh: 对，他们自己写作业的好名声。

sentences.en: But he's doing it so that he can earn money to buy a motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 但他这么做是为了赚钱买摩托车。

sentences.en: Louie comes to what we learn is Michael's uncle's nuclear fallout shelter,
sentences.zh: 路易来到了我们得知是迈克尔叔叔的核防空洞的地方，

sentences.en: where I guess Michael hangs out and does his homework.
sentences.zh: 我想迈克尔就是在那儿闲逛并写作业的。

sentences.en: I said, does he live in his uncle's fallout shelter or just do his homework in there?
sentences.zh: 我说，他是住在叔叔的防空洞里，还是只是在那儿写作业？

sentences.en: Either way, kind of makes me sad.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，这让我有点难过。

sentences.en: He looks around and is like, oh, this is a good place to do homework and other things.
sentences.zh: 他环顾四周，心想，哦，这是个写作业和其他事情的好地方。

sentences.en: It looks like he pays Michael what appears to be $5.
sentences.zh: 看起来他付给迈克尔了大约 5 美元。

sentences.en: I looked up what a motorcycle costs in 1961.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下 1961 年摩托车的价格。

sentences.en: I mean, he gets a pretty junky motorcycle that he has to fix up through a series of montages.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他买了一辆挺破的摩托车，还得通过一连串的蒙太奇镜头把它修好。

sentences.en: He goes to like basically a junkyard.

sentences.zh: 只要让我坐在你的摩托车上就行。

sentences.en: Maybe this is a relationship in silence.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一段无声的恋情。

sentences.en: Well, this whole thing is going to morph into graduation.
sentences.zh: 好了，这一切将过渡到毕业典礼。

sentences.en: Now we're back outside Rydell High.
sentences.zh: 现在我们回到了赖德尔高中外面。

sentences.en: Everyone's in caps and gowns in front of the school.
sentences.zh: 每个人都穿着学士服、戴着学士帽站在学校前面。

sentences.en: They're throwing their caps in the air.
Everyone's singing toward the camera, except for Stephanie and Michael, who are still singing right into each other's faces.
sentences.zh: 每个人都对着镜头唱歌，除了斯蒂芬妮和迈克尔，他们依然面对面地互相对唱。

sentences.en: And then we're going to have this final montage that I've always loved.
sentences.zh: 然后我们将迎来我一直很喜欢的最后这个蒙太奇。

sentences.en: It starts with the whole group of people running toward the camera.
sentences.zh: 开始时是所有人一起朝着镜头跑来。

sentences.en: They jump in the air, and it's like a freeze frame.
sentences.zh: 他们跳到空中，画面就像定格了一样。

sentences.en: And that sort of becomes like a yearbook picture.
sentences.zh: 这有点像毕业纪念册的照片。

sentences.en: And then you see everybody kind of coupled up in their couple pairs, and they run toward the camera kind of in slow motion, and they do some sort of fun jump, and it freezes.
sentences.zh: 然后你看到每个人都成双成对地朝着镜头慢动作奔跑，他们做了一个有趣的跳跃动作，然后画面定格。

sentences.en: And that's part of the yearbook.
sentences.zh: 这也是毕业纪念册的一部分。

sentences.en: There were two alternate endings for this movie.
sentences.zh: 这部电影有两个备用结局。

sentences.en: Would you like to hear them?
So, one alternate ending had Michael and Stephanie flying off into the sky on a motorcycle, which would have mirrored Danny and Sandy flying off in the car at the end of Greece.
sentences.zh: 其中一个备用结局是迈克尔和斯蒂芬妮骑着摩托车飞向天空，这呼应了《油脂》结尾时丹尼和桑迪开车飞走的场景。

sentences.en: Patricia Birch proposed an idea to feature John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John reprising their characters as a now-married couple running a gas station at the end of the movie,
sentences.zh: 帕特里夏·伯奇提出了一个想法，即让约翰·特拉沃尔塔和奥莉维亚·牛顿-约翰重新扮演他们的角色，以已婚夫妇的身份在电影结尾经营一家加油站，

sentences.en: and it would have even involved John Travolta singing a new number called Gas Pump Jockey.
sentences.zh: 甚至还包括约翰·特拉沃尔塔演唱一首名为《加油机管理员》的新歌。

sentences.en: But this did not come to fruition.
So, I guess there was the option to end the movie with a little cameo.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想当时确实可以选择以一个小客串来结束这部电影。

sentences.en: So, I guess they would have ridden their motorcycle together.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想他们会一起骑着摩托车。

sentences.en: To Danny and Sandy's gas station.
sentences.zh: 去丹尼和桑迪的加油站。

sentences.en: And there would have been this little reunion.
sentences.zh: 然后会有这样一个小小的重聚。

sentences.en: How does Gas Pump Jockey go?
Speaking of songs, so you watched this movie for the first time.
sentences.zh: 说到歌曲，你这是第一次看这部电影。

sentences.en: You know these songs are good because you hear them once, and you can sing, I Want to Score Tonight.
sentences.zh: 你知道这些歌很好，因为你听过一次，就能唱出《我今晚要得分》。

sentences.en: You can sing, Let's Do It for Our Country.
sentences.zh: 你能唱出《为了我们的国家，我们干吧》。

sentences.en: You know these songs after one time watching the movie.
sentences.zh: 看了一遍电影后，你就知道这些歌了。

sentences.en: Driving in here today, I was singing, I'm going to score tonight.
sentences.zh: 今天开车来这儿的路上，我一直在唱“我今晚要得分”。
那是一部很棒的音乐剧。

sentences.en: That is a really fun musical.
sentences.zh: 那真是一部非常有趣的音乐剧。

sentences.en: And really, Greece, too, has everything.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，《油脂》里什么都有。

sentences.en: You guys, I highly recommend it.
And I also want to say thank you today.
In the booth, we have Jordan filling in for Sam.
sentences.zh: 演播室里，由乔丹代替萨姆。

sentences.en: I was so excited to be helping with this episode because I grew up avidly watching Greece, too.
sentences.zh: 我非常兴奋能参与这期节目的制作，因为我从小也狂热地看《油脂2》。

sentences.en: How many times have you seen it?
I had a vinyl of it growing up.
sentences.zh: 我从小就有一张它的黑胶唱片。

sentences.en: Because my parents, they graduated in 72.
sentences.zh: 因为我的父母，他们是72届的。

sentences.en: I literally, my dad rode a motorcycle and worked on them his entire life.
sentences.zh: 我真的，我爸爸骑了一辈子摩托车，也修了一辈子摩托车。

sentences.en: I have pictures of him doing wheelies and next to, like, motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 我有他玩翘头以及和摩托车合影的照片。

sentences.en: Your dad was a cool writer, Jordan.
sentences.zh: 你爸爸是个酷车手，乔丹。

sentences.en: And Matt is here all the way from San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 马特也大老远从旧金山赶来了。

sentences.en: Matt, thanks for being here today.
This was very fun to watch.
My sister and I are Greece purists, so we never really delved into this.
sentences.zh: 我和我姐姐是《油脂》的纯粹主义者，所以我们从没真正涉足过这部。

sentences.en: So this was interesting to watch.

sentences.zh: 我度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: Well, I want to say a thank you to Nathan for suggesting this movie.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我要感谢内森推荐了这部电影。

sentences.en: Let us know, what do you want us to watch?
sentences.zh: 让我们知道，你们想让我们看什么？

sentences.en: Because we like watching stuff together.
sentences.zh: 因为我们喜欢一起看东西。

sentences.en: I couldn't have predicted half of the plot lines for Greece, too.
sentences.zh: 我根本预料不到《油脂2》里一半的剧情走向。

sentences.en: And I hope you guys all score tonight, whatever that means to you.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们今晚都能有所收获，无论对你们意味着什么。

sentences.en: We love you, and we'll see you next week.
sentences.zh: 我们爱你们，我们下周见。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to Office Ladies.
Office Ladies is a presentation of Odyssey and is produced by Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》是奥德赛的节目，由珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金西制作。

sentences.en: Our senior producer is Matt Beagle.
sentences.zh: 我们的资深制作人是马特·比格尔。

sentences.en: And our audio engineer is Sam Kiefer.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频工程师是萨姆·基弗。

sentences.en: Odyssey's executive producer is Leah Reese Dennis.
sentences.zh: 奥德赛的执行制作人是莉亚·里斯·丹尼斯。

sentences.en: Office Ladies was mixed and mastered by Bill Schultz.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由比尔·舒尔茨进行混音和母带制作。

sentences.en: Our theme song is Rupertree by Creed Bratton.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是克里德·布拉顿创作的鲁珀特树。
